description: This file defines the 'soap_parser' class, which extends 'nusoap_base'. The class handles parsing of SOAP XML messages into PHP variables, including processing SOAP headers, body, and complex types. It includes methods for starting and ending XML elements, handling character data, decoding simple types, and building PHP structures from parsed XML nodes.

classes.name: soap_parser
classes.description: A class for parsing SOAP XML messages into PHP data structures, supporting header and body processing, complex type handling, and value decoding.

methods.name: soap_parser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser, sets up XML parsing, and processes the SOAP message.

methods.name: start_element
methods.description: Handles the beginning of an XML element, setting up message node information.

methods.name: end_element
methods.description: Handles the closing of an XML element, building PHP structures from XML nodes.

methods.name: character_data
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements, accumulating text content.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the SOAP headers extracted from the message.

methods.name: decodeSimple
methods.description: Decodes XML simple types into corresponding PHP types.

methods.name: buildVal
methods.description: Builds PHP values for complex types (arrays, structs) and simple content based on parsed XML nodes.
